issues.text: Run 1: wire the 4 devices as a daisy chain, one after another. Star and T connections are not allowed.
The data bus is 3300 ft, close to the 4000 ft limit.
A data bus hub is the preferred way to wire a bus with several devices (new wiring: M1DBH with CAT5/6 home runs; reusing 4-conductor cable: M1DBHR). A direct bus is limited to two runs.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): INSTALL it. With one run, the control end is the second of the two termination points.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Daisy chain: control → Keypad (address 1) → Keypad (address 2) → Keypad (address 3) → Keypad (address 4). About 3300 ft.
Terminate the last device only: Keypad (address 4). Fit its terminating jumper. Do not terminate the others.

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
